title: Seating capacity of the premises
summary: How many customers you can seat in a space based on its total area.

what: It's the reverse of the dining room area: given a space for rent, how many covers fit.
It lets you check right away whether a space suits your project, before negotiating the rent.
formula: Dining room area = premises area × share for the dining room (≈ 55%)
Covers = dining room area ÷ area per customer with circulation

variables.name: Premises area
variables.description: The total square meters of the space.

variables.name: Dining room share
variables.description: Between 45% and 65%; the handbook uses 55% as a reference.

variables.name: Area per customer with circulation
variables.description: The area per person with walkways already included (for example, 1.30 m²).

steps: Multiply the premises area by the dining room share.
Divide that area by the area per customer with circulation.
Round down: that's how many covers fit.

examples.title: 80 m² premises (handbook)
paragraphs: The dining room takes about 55%: 80 m² × 55% = 44 m².
At 1.30 m² per person: 44 ÷ 1.30 = 33.8, that is, 33 covers.
If the project needs 40 covers, this space isn't big enough.

notes.text: The handbook writes "the resulting 45 m² (55% of 80 m²)" and gets 34 covers, but 55% of 80 m² is 44 m², which gives 33 covers.
Covers are rounded down: a fraction of a seat isn't enough for one more person without making everyone else less comfortable.

dining-share-percentage.label: Share for the dining room
dining-share-percentage.placeholder: Percentage of the premises for dining, between 45 and 65 (e.g. 55)
dining-share-percentage.hint: The rest is kitchen (15–25%) and storage and services (20–35%).

area-per-customer-with-circulation.label: Area per customer with circulation
area-per-customer-with-circulation.placeholder: Square meters per person including walkways (e.g. 1.30)

steps.dining-area: Dining room = premises area × {diningSharePercentage} = {premisesArea} m² × {diningSharePercentage} = {diningArea} m²
steps.capacity: Covers = dining room ÷ area per customer = {diningArea} m² ÷ {areaPerCustomerWithCirculation} m² = {capacity} (rounded down)
